parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *ohta- + -ke, possibly borrowed from Proto-Baltic *ašta-.

parole.significato: pigtail, the tail of a pig
parole.testo: Proto-Finnic *sapa(ra) + -o, borrowed from Proto-Baltic *stabara-, compare Lithuanian stabaras (“dried branch”) and Latvian stebere (“cow's tail”). Cognate with Estonian saba (“tail”).
Proto-Finnic *takijas + -inen (compare Estonian takjas, Ludian takkiaińe, Veps takkiž), borrowed from Proto-Baltic *dagijas (compare Latvian dadzis, Lithuanian dagys).
